title: Input
description: Through mouse or keyboard input content, it is the most basic form field wrapper.
whenToUse:
- A user input in a form field is needed.
- A search input is required.

examples.name: Basic usage
Three sizes of Input
examples.description: There are three sizes of an Input box: `large` (40px), `medium` (32px) and `small` (24px).

examples.name: Variants
examples.description: Variants of Input, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.

examples.name: Compact Style
examples.description: Use Space.Compact create compact style, See the Space.Compact documentation for more.

examples.name: Search box
examples.description: Example of creating a search box by grouping a standard input with a search button.

examples.name: Search box with loading
TextArea
Autosizing the height to fit the content
examples.description: `autoSize` prop for a `textarea` type of `Input` makes the height to automatically adjust based on the content. An option object can be provided to `autoSize` to specify the minimum and maximum number of lines the textarea will automatically adjust.

examples.name: OTP
Format Tooltip Input
examples.description: You can use the Input in conjunction with Tooltip component to create a Numeric Input, which can provide a good experience for extra-long content display.

examples.name: prefix and suffix
examples.description: Add a prefix or suffix icons inside input. Note: The `suffix` prop for Input.Password is supported starting from version `5.27.0`.

examples.name: Password box
With clear icon
examples.description: Input box with the remove icon, click the icon to delete everything.

examples.name: With character counting
= 5.10.0">Custom count logic
examples.description: It is necessary to customize the counting ability in some scenarios (such as emoji length is counted as 1), which can be achieved through the `count` attribute. Use `count.max` attribute exceeds the limit of the native `maxLength`.

examples.name: Status
examples.description: Add status to Input with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

examples.name: Focus
Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Input by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
